blocks.text: Comedian Gil Aducal Morales, popularly known as Ate Gay, has remained in critical condition and is currently relying on life support after suffering septic shock, acute respiratory failure secondary to pneumonia, and stroke. Morales’ family gave an update on his condition while reiterating their appeal for financial help through a statement released on his Facebook page on Friday, Oct. 30.
